description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Double Sphere Mode (Fire, Dark)], [Awoken Legend], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Perfection Mode] to the user

description.name: Double Sphere Mode (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Dark] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Awoken Legend
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Perfection Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire Perfection Mode]/[Dark Perfection Mode] after using a Fire/Dark ability
